## Hinge question · Does the sum exist? {#ss7-hinge .lim-lesson .sequence-hinge .lim-hinge}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="4" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">A student claims that <span data-math="6-9+\frac{27}{2}-\cdots">6 − 9 + 27/2 − …</span> has limiting sum <span data-math="\frac{6}{1+\frac32}=\frac{12}{5}">6/(1 + 3/2) = 12/5</span>.<br>Which response is correct?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>Correct, because <span data-math="r<1">r &lt; 1</span>.</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>Correct, because <span data-math="r\ne1">r ≠ 1</span>.</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>Incorrect, because <span data-math="r">r</span> is negative.</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>Incorrect, because <span data-math="|r|>1">|r| &gt; 1</span>.</span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>4.</strong> Here <span data-math="r=-\frac32">r = −3/2</span>, so <span data-math="|r|=\frac32>1">|r| = 3/2 &gt; 1</span>. The terms grow in magnitude and there is no limiting sum.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes

Correct answer 4. Choice 1 checks only r<1 and misses the lower bound −1. Choice 2 confuses the finite-sum condition r≠1 with convergence. Choice 3 reaches the right yes/no verdict for the wrong reason: negative ratios with |r|<1 do converge. Ask for a justification, not only whether the student is wrong. Ready: contrast r=−3/2 with r=−1/2. Divided: place both ratios on a number line and re-poll. Reteach: list terms 6,−9,13.5,−20.25 and revisit the ratio explorer. Default 60 seconds, adjustable start/pause/reset. Collect 1–4 fingers simultaneously on the teacher’s verbal cue. Timer expiry must not reveal the answer. Reset clears answer, selection and timer.

:::
